title: Freestanding Coat Rack, 60-Inch, Solid Brass, 8 Pivoting Pegs | Assorted Free Standing Accessories | Allied Brass
body_html:
Stop piling coats, hats, and towels on countertops—create an organized bathroom drop zone with a freestanding rack that needs no wall mounting.

  • Keep items separated and reachable with eight pivoting pegs designed to organize coats, hats, and accessories.
  • Place it anywhere in the bath thanks to a freestanding design that requires no drilling.
  • Stay stable on the floor with a weighted base designed to prevent tipping.
  • Protect your surfaces using the built-in felt pad that helps prevent scratching.
  • Coordinate a cohesive look as part of the Assorted Free Standing Accessories collection, offered in multiple designer finish options.

Specs & Details
Material: Solid brass construction
Product dimensions (L x H x W): 10 x 60 x 10 in.
Box dimensions (L x H x W): 26 x 26 x 12 in.
Shipping weight: 18 lbs.
Assembly: Some assembly required

_previous.title: Freestanding Coat Rack with Eight Pivoting Pegs
_previous.description: Keeping your coats, hats and other accessories organized is now easier than ever, with this freestanding coat rack, with eight pivoting pegs. Its eight pivoting pegs are displayed in an innovative manner, which creates a truly organized space for your coats and hats. Nicely designed, this coat rack is an excellent choice not only for its performance, but also for its ability to add some style to the overall decor.
